key.name: usage-command
key.summary: Command that prints usage as JSON
key.description: Run on every refresh without a shell. Its standard input is empty and it inherits GNOME Shell's environment, including PATH. It must print a JSON object of the form {"reports": [...]} on standard output and exit 0; the report format is documented in Burnline's README. The first word is looked up on PATH, or used as an absolute path to an executable.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the usage command is run. Values are also marked stale when they are older than eight minutes or twice this interval, whichever is longer.
